label.explanation: events was restored from a snapshot but its id AUTO_INCREMENT was left behind the restored rows (line 210). New inserts are handed ids that already exist and violate the primary key (lines 235, 241, 245, 257, 267). ingest-api's create failures (lines 234, 256, 280, 305, 320, 345) and ingest-gateway errors (lines 228, 240, 252, 255, 269, 283, 291, 304, 321, 325, 335, 353) follow. Reset the sequence past max(id). Red herrings: line 218 (a config reload that changed nothing); line 226 (a one-off slow reporting query on audit_log, not on the failing request path); line 69 (a certificate expiry reminder weeks out).
